shortDesc: Matrix-neuron neural network research library — custom deep learning experiments built from scratch in JAX.
fullDesc:
MATNETS is a pure JAX research experiment that proposes a departure from conventional scalar neuron models. Instead of a scalar activation, MATNETS endows every neuron with an n × n matrix.

Core Idea:
In conventional networks, forward propagation involves element-wise operations. MATNETS uses a tensor contraction formulation (via jax.numpy.einsum) to perform true matrix multiplication along inner indices for every neuron connection. This changes weight contractions into matrix-product operators and activation functions into structural transformations.

The library is built directly on JAX primitives to support out-of-the-box JIT compilation, vectorisation (vmap), auto-differentiation (grad), and custom training loops.

reports.title: MATNETS Research Report
reports.desc: Algebraically-rich deep learning in JAX: core matrix-neuron formulation, neural layers, and MNIST parameter efficiency.

highlights: Replaces scalar neurons with matrix-valued neurons (n × n activations)
Propagates computations via full matrix multiplication instead of element-wise operations
Written natively in JAX supporting jit, vmap, and grad
Maintains competitive accuracy (~98.5% MNIST) at a fraction of standard parameters
